body: - 2026-10-10: On the Linux dev host the bare name `claude` can resolve to a newer CLI than the home is stamped for, so a live rig that needs the stamped version puts that version's install directory first on its host process's `PATH` and reads `claude --version` by path before its first start; a `viola revive` typed there with no `PATH` change runs the unstamped CLI. Extended 2026-10-20: `claude --mcp-config <configs...>` is variadic, so a rig that passes it gives the prompt on stdin with nothing positional after the option, and files the CLI's stderr privately, recording only its byte count and hash prefix — a start that exits early otherwise leaves no cause to read. Extended 2026-11-13: the newest installed CLI can move between a plan and its live proof (a `mise`-managed `latest`), so a plan entry naming a CLI version by literal is re-read against `mise ls claude` at the proof, and a newer install moves the proof only on the operator's word. Extended 2026-11-17: a plan's gate entry that names an installed CLI's path is read against the host's install before the plan's review card, since a `mise` install holds `<version dir>/claude` with no `bin/` and a guessed layout reads red only at the live round.

- 2026-11-17: A change to what the fake agent draws under `--screens` reaches `cli_verify`'s `viola verify --record` recorded-screen cases, which select by the stamped verify run rather than by the file touched, so a plan changing the fake's screens puts `cli_verify` in its gate block.

body:
The session added one standing, committed, test-only live rig, the binary viola-live-rig in the viola-e2e test crate. It drives a wrapped claude child on its own PTY, reads the screen through a vt100 model into closed words, passes the trust dialog with a read-first key grant, and keeps its own isolation, credentials handling and process census.
Its rehearsals run in CI against the fake agent as a new integration test binary, rig_rehearsal. Its live starts against the real claude 2.1.325 run only by hand under a start cap of 2 plus 1 spare, and the live verb refuses to start under CI.
The fake agent under --screens with an untrusted cwd now draws claude 2.1.325's unnumbered trust form over the recorded modal, with the selector first on No, exit. It also draws a box rule and a prompt row on each typed key, and DEL erases the prompt's last character, receipted as a key.
Live it measured that claude 2.1.325 keeps a leading run of spaces at submit, removes a trailing run of spaces and TAB, and keeps inner runs and an inner LF. The user's claude.json read unchanged under a private CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.
The product binary is unchanged: no product diagnostics line, event, span, exit code or schema moved, and nothing was retired.

Rows that ban telemetry from screen content and never log the PTY byte stream. The rig reads the child's screen into closed words and keeps screen frames as files, test-only, under a gitignored target directory. That is a test-side screen reading beside rows that rule only over the product.

Rows that never log secrets or signing credentials and keep home-level lines path-free. The rig reads a credentials file, parses only its expiry, places the bytes 0600 in scratch and removes them on every exit path. A rehearsal asserts that no record holds a credential or host path.

Rows that put integration-test homes under one scanned root. The rig's scratch base is a private directory under /tmp per user, outside the e2e home, and the rehearsals place their scratch per case.

Rows saying wrapped claude internals and transcripts are no contract. The rig reads claude 2.1.325's trust dialog form by screen literals: unnumbered, with the selector first on No, exit and the trust row below it. These are live readings of CLI internals, held only by the test crate.

Rows on no print macros and no telemetry on stdout. The rig prints its closed-word summary as key: word lines on stdout. It sits in a test-only crate outside the product code paths, an exception any row whose scope reaches harness binaries would need.

Rows on no sleep-based log waits. The rig and its rehearsal wait with bounded settle and deadline windows: settle 6 s, deadline 15 s, and a rehearsal WITHIN of 18 s, set under the contract lint's 20 s floor and the 30 s viola-e2e kill line.

Any obs-plan row that words the send trim. R2 measured claude 2.1.325 keeping a leading run of spaces, removing trailing spaces and TAB, and keeping inner runs and LF. A rule that reads trailing-only stays true, and a cell that calls the trim set unmeasured or a leading trim open is now stale.

The rig isolates each start: the child runs under a private CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR in a scratch removed at teardown, a credentials copy placed 0600 and removed on every exit path, a start refused below 20 minutes of token window, and the user's claude config read only as a sha256 prefix and mtime that must read unchanged.

The rig marks its child with AGENT_RUN_RIG set to its pid and start time; its census reaches only processes carrying its marker or under its scratch cwd, verified by pid and start time; census --kill reaches only a dead rig's leftovers; its stop presses Ctrl-C every 500 ms up to 10 s before the process group's SIGKILL, and a watchdog deadline raises the same stop.

viola-live-rig exits 0 for a whole start, 1 for a start read red, 2 for usage and 3 for a refusal before the ledger line; it prints closed key: word summary lines and one summary line in its ledger, its refusal words a closed list (ci, spent, cap, version, token-window, leftover, ledger, scratch, credentials, spawn, viola, shape, no-session-start, texts, key-not-granted, key-not-ready, key-write-failed, trust-unpassed), trust-moves reading a count, needs-up, needs-third-move or unread.

The fake agent under its screens mode with an untrusted cwd draws claude 2.1.325's unnumbered trust form over the set's recorded modal, the selector first on No, exit directly above the recorded trust row (row 16 with no recorded modal); arrows move the selector, Enter on the trust row draws the ready screen and fires the launch SessionStart, Enter on No exits 1, and no hook fires before it.
The fake agent draws a box rule and a prompt row on each typed key, and a DEL erases the prompt's last character, UTF-8 aware, receipted as a key.

The submit trim of claude 2.1.325 is measured live: a leading run of spaces is kept, a trailing run of spaces and TAB is removed, an inner run and an inner LF are kept; the trailing-trim tolerance rests on that reading, no longer on an assumption.
